text: {"summary":"CBS canceled the struggling sitcom “We Are Men” and will bring “Mike and Molly” back on November 4. Starting October 14, “2 Broke Girls” will fill the 8:30 p.m. slot, with “The Big Bang Theory” repeats airing at 9 p.m. until “Mike and Molly” takes over."}

{ "summary": "Scientists worry that Finding Dory could spur demand for blue tangs as pets, as Finding Nemo did for clownfish. Unlike clownfish, blue tangs are difficult to breed in captivity, and poorly regulated harvesting in their native waters could damage ecosystems; the film’s message is that fish belong in the wild." }

{ "summary": "About 40 attendees at a Tony Robbins seminar in Dallas were burned during a hot-coal walk, likely because they lingered on the embers while taking photos. Firewalking can be done safely when coals are properly burned down and walkers keep a steady pace, but small mistakes can cause injuries." }

{ "summary": "The article recommends 12 acclaimed 2016 films available to stream, including Netflix picks such as *The Jungle Book*, *13th*, *Barry*, and *Zootopia*, plus *Whiskey Tango Foxtrot* on Hulu. The selections span documentaries, dramas, animation, horror, and superhero action, with brief notes on each film’s themes and appeal." }

{"summary":"HuffPost curates 29 influential pieces published in 2016 by women, spanning essays, reporting, fiction and satire on feminism, race, sexual violence, politics, poverty and identity. The collection celebrates women’s voices as vital journalism and a source of insight, solidarity and resistance in a turbulent year."}

{ "summary": "Ratan Tata said he felt lonely and hurt by what he described as unsubstantiated attacks on his reputation and the Tata Group amid the ongoing dispute with former chairman Cyrus Mistry. Speaking at a Tata Chemicals shareholders’ meeting, he thanked shareholders for their strong support and said he believed the truth would prevail." }
{"summary":"The food industry plans to make product labels easier for shoppers to understand. The changes are expected to appear in grocery stores soon."}

{ "summary": "A playful roundup of 19 teens who made headlines or went viral in 2016 for unusual, funny, or memorable antics—from a Mulan-inspired school ID and creative senior photos to a deer friendship, a dinosaur-costume homecoming queen, and a Pokémon Go player who discovered a body." }

{ "summary": "Cinematographer Dean Cundey revealed that human characters in John Carpenter’s The Thing are given a small gleam of light in their eyes, while the alien may lack it—a subtle visual clue intended to hint at who remains human. The detail appears in a new commentary accompanying the film’s upcoming Blu-ray release." }

{"summary":"The Commerce Commission’s 2016 Consumer Issues Paper found Spark received the most complaints (140), followed by Vodafone (133) and Trade Me sellers (121); pricing was the most common issue. The Commission cautioned that complaints do not prove wrongdoing, while also highlighting that non-bank lenders account for 43% of credit-related complaints despite holding just 3% of the credit market."}

{ "summary": "Arkansas bikers Bret and Zach Winingar found an emaciated puppy trapped in a chewed-up crate, rescued her, and took her for veterinary care. They adopted her as Charlie Bravo (CB); after she recovered, donations inspired the family to start a charity called CB’s Angels." }

{"summary":"McLaren plans to invest £1 billion ($1.45 billion) in research and development over six years to launch 15 new cars by 2022 and increase annual sales from 2,000 to 5,000. The lineup is expected to include hybrid and electric models, supported by new powertrains and carbon-fiber structures as the company responds to emissions rules and competition with Ferrari."}

{ "summary": "Well + Good experts tout bone broth as a nutrient-rich drink that may support bone and skin health and offer relief for digestive, skin, or immunity issues, recommending high-quality bones. It is made by simmering bones with vegetables, herbs, and vinegar for 8–24 hours, keeps refrigerated for up to four days, and can be enjoyed as a filling breakfast." }

{"summary":"Amateur archaeologists have uncovered a previously undocumented passage beneath Hadrian’s Villa in Tivoli, Italy, linking the Academy area to a major underground road. The tunnels, carved by slaves, let workers, merchants, and carts serve the estate out of sight; the newly found route’s specific purpose remains unknown."}

{"summary":"ScHoolboy Q said in a new interview that he nearly quit rap after *Oxymoron*, having spent long stretches away from music and missed much of his daughter’s early childhood. He said he doesn’t want to put his career ahead of his family, leaving fans to wonder whether he may step away from rap again."}

{"summary":"The article questions whether NBC’s “The Biggest Loser” delivered lasting change, arguing that contestants’ dramatic weight loss—achieved through as much as eight hours of daily training—may have been only temporary. It challenges the show’s portrayal of transforming contestants’ bodies and lives for good."}

{ "summary": "This satirical article invents absurd GTA VI “leaks” about characters, improved physics, online play, radio, mature content, and costly in-game purchases. It explicitly notes that the claims are fictional and part of a weekly satire column." }

{"summary":"Jessica Simpson wore an all-black outfit with skinny jeans and stilettos for a family dinner with fiancé Eric Johnson and daughter Maxwell, three months after giving birth to son Ace. She said she feels fulfilled as a mother and isn’t planning more children, while hinting she may return to making music."}

{ "summary": "The article recommends 20 smartphone apps designed to encourage outdoor activities, from walking, cycling, camping and wildlife spotting to stargazing, fishing, geocaching and skateboarding. The apps offer practical tools such as maps, routes, forecasts and activity guides, alongside games and social features that help users explore and connect." }

{ "summary": "The article says ceiling-fan blade counts reflect how fans are used: in the US, four-blade fans typically run more slowly to circulate air alongside air conditioning, while in India, three-blade fans spin faster and provide cooling on their own. Their lighter design is also described as more energy efficient." }

{"summary":"EA announced that the Battlefield 1 open beta will end on September 8. A patch removes the time limit in Sinai Desert Conquest, while planned server stress tests may cause downtime; the full game launches worldwide on October 21."}

{"summary":"The article highlights 15 lesser-known Tesla facts, including Elon Musk’s plan for model names to spell “SEXY,” future plans for an electric bus and semitruck, and playful Easter eggs inspired by Mario Kart, James Bond, and SpaceX. It also notes the Model S’s safety and industry milestones, including a record roof-crush score, a Motor Trend Car of the Year award, and a range exceeding 300 miles."}

{ "summary": "Elizabeth Warren insists she is not running for president, but her new book’s account of repeatedly overcoming reluctance to take on influential roles makes a case for seeking greater power. Its themes of fighting for working families, expanding opportunity and acting on one’s convictions may keep fueling calls for a presidential run." }

{"summary":"Nine-year-old Molly Sings gives an emotional blind audition on The Voice Kids Australia, performing a song about insecurity that moves the judges and visibly proud family. Afterward, Mel B praises Molly’s control and confidence and encourages her to choose her as a coach, appealing to their shared girl power."}

{"summary":"Bill Maher urged TV hosts interviewing President-elect Donald Trump to treat him as a politician and challenge his statements rather than let him use their shows. Maher said he would welcome Trump on “Real Time,” noting that Trump’s unpredictability could make an appearance possible early in the show’s new season."}

{"summary":"Lindsay Lohan shared an Instagram photo of herself and her sister, singer Ali Lohan, recording with Duran Duran members Simon Le Bon and Nick Rhodes. The news follows Lindsay’s recent West End appearance in Speed-the-Plow and the end of her probation related to a 2011 necklace theft."}

{ "summary": "The article predicts the traditional 9-to-5 workday will become uncommon as millennials prioritize flexibility, work-family balance, training, and remote work. It argues that technology and lower office costs will help make telecommuting standard, while studies suggesting flexible schedules improve productivity may persuade employers to adopt them." }

{ "summary": "The small plastic tripod in pizza boxes is a “pizza saver,” invented by Carmela Vitale in 1983 to keep sagging lids from sticking to the cheese. Though Vitale patented the design, she never manufactured it, and her patent lapsed in 1993; today, the inexpensive devices are used widely to protect delivered pizzas." }

{"summary":"Experiments by Yonat Zwebner and colleagues found that people can match a person’s headshot to their correct name more often than chance. The findings suggest that people may come to resemble the names they are given."}

{"summary":"After a study found that former “Biggest Loser” contestants often regained weight and burned fewer calories than expected, host Bob Harper suggested intermittent fasting as one possible way to manage substantial weight loss. Research indicates it can support short-term weight loss, but its long-term effectiveness is unknown, and fasting may be unsafe for some people or hard to sustain."}

{"summary":"“Glee” star Alex Newell has joined the cast of “Geography Club,” a film adaptation of Brent Hartinger’s novel, alongside Marin Hinkle, Meaghan Martin and others. Newell said the script appealed to him because he hopes the film will help audiences better understand the experiences of transgender people."}

{ "summary": "Galbani’s string-cheese packaging uses male-looking cartoon characters for its full-fat products and a female character for reduced-fat versions. A parent told Jezebel the gendered branding stood out after their five-year-old daughter asked for the “girl cheese.”" }

{"summary":"The article ranks New York’s 10 worst sports seasons, from the 1972-73 Islanders and other historically poor teams to the 1983-88 Columbia football team, whose 44-game losing streak tops the list. The struggling 2014-15 Knicks rank second, with the author noting their potential to challenge the NBA’s worst record."}

{ "summary": "Google established a subsidiary, Google Auto LLC, in 2011 to legally operate its self-driving car project and register its 23 Lexus test vehicles, according to documents obtained by The Guardian. The company may have created the LLC to limit liability, and although it is licensed as a vehicle manufacturer, Google says it plans to work with established automakers to build its cars." }

{ "summary": "Veteran New York Times television reporter Bill Carter is taking a voluntary buyout after more than 25 years at the paper, citing the generous severance and economic pressures despite his love for the job. Known for his coverage of late-night TV and books including *The Late Shift*, he plans to write another book and seek new work as the Times pursues 100 buyouts while continuing to hire in growth areas." }

{ "summary": "Alternative food-price indexes—from Starbucks lattes and pizza to Hooters wings and Nobu’s black cod—offer a playful way to compare currencies and purchasing power. They generally suggest the dollar is overvalued against the yen and pound, while London’s high dining prices make sterling look especially expensive; pizza prices also point to an undervalued euro." }

{"summary":"At its Comic-Con panel after season four, Orphan Black shared a blooper reel alongside a playful ad-lib challenge for the cast. In the clip, Tatiana Maslany, playing Cosima, tells someone on the phone they need to talk to Cosima—a mistake she may often make while playing multiple characters."}

{ "summary": "Fasting is still listed as preferred in U.S. cholesterol-testing guidelines, but research shows eating beforehand has little effect on total, HDL or LDL cholesterol results; it can raise triglycerides somewhat. Many European guidelines no longer require fasting, and cardiologists say nonfasting tests can make screening easier and offer a realistic picture of typical lipid levels." }

{ "summary": "A couple in Gujarat’s Dahod district opted for a tubectomy after having 17 children—16 daughters and one son—following persuasion from village elders. The father said they kept expanding their family in hopes of having another son, despite struggling to support the children through farming and labor." }

{ "summary": "After three baby genets were orphaned in South Africa, rescue-center co-founder Ian and Michelle Merrifield cared for them with help from their dog Candy, who began producing milk and became their devoted, protective foster mother. Two genets were later released into the wild, while Chouchou remained at the center because she struggled with the transition." }

{ "summary": "GrubHub’s analysis of orders at more than 350 campuses found Syracuse University students had the highest share of late-night orders, with one in four placed between 10 p.m. and 2 a.m. College students overall were more likely to order late at night, less likely to order breakfast or healthier meals, and spent less per order than the average diner." }

{ "summary": "After hearing a missionary describe how babies in a Ugandan orphanage had stopped crying because no one responded to them, Michigan mother Dayna Mager promised to comfort her daughter whenever she cried. Her husband later found her asleep in the baby’s crib beside Luella, and a photo of the moment spread widely online." }

{ "summary": "Mars will launch M&M’s Mega in May 2014, offering original and peanut varieties with three times the chocolate of regular M&M’s. Bags will cost $1.49 for a small milk-chocolate pack and $3.29 for a medium pack." }

{"summary":"Nintendo’s $60 NES Classic Edition includes 30 preloaded games but can’t connect to the internet or external storage, so owners won’t be able to add more. The console is designed as a simple nostalgia device for casual players, rather than a feature-rich option for hardcore gaming enthusiasts."}

{"summary":"The article offers low-effort health tips for people who aren’t going to the gym, including cutting back on sugary juice, improving posture and breathing, gardening, stretching or moving for 10 minutes, walking, and taking breaks from anxiety-inducing social media. It also recommends relaxing in a bath, not suppressing sneezes, and drinking a glass of warm water."}

{"summary":"A Lovehoney survey of 4,400 customers found that sex lasted an average of 19 minutes, including 10 minutes of foreplay. While just over half were satisfied, many wanted longer, and respondents said quickies occurred 21% of the time; the article cautions that the company’s customers may not represent the wider population."}

{"summary":"A farmer in Carlos Spegazzini, Argentina, uncovered a fossil in his backyard on Christmas Day. Paleontologists identified it as the shell of a glyptodon, a giant armadillo relative from the Pleistocene that could weigh up to two tons; the fossil is at least 10,000 years old."}

{"summary":"After a fire damaged student Ben Schofield’s truck and burned the American flag he flew from it, classmates rushed to put out the flames; police and school officials are investigating, with another student suspected. The next day, dozens of students rallied in patriotic colors, and Ben returned to school flying a flag again."}

{"summary":"The USDA approved four Chinese poultry processors to export cooked chicken to the U.S., initially using birds raised in America. Critics cite China’s food-safety record and warn the approval could pave the way for Chinese-raised poultry; because cooked products need no origin label and USDA inspectors won’t supervise plants on-site, consumers may not know where their chicken was processed."}

{"summary":"“Newsroom” actor Alison Pill told Conan O’Brien that a touchscreen BlackBerry mistake caused her to tweet a topless photo accidentally. She called the incident dumb and hideously embarrassing, saying she worried for months that new acquaintances had seen the image; she deleted it and apologized soon after it was posted."}

{ "summary": "Mixing milk and Coca-Cola causes the milk proteins to curdle and settle, a visible reaction attributed to the cola’s phosphoric acid. The article links this demonstration to research suggesting phosphoric acid may contribute to lower bone density among regular cola drinkers, while noting that the evidence is not conclusive and more research is needed." }

{"summary":"Labrador retrievers remained America’s most popular AKC-registered breed in 2016, extending their record streak at No. 1 to 26 years. Rottweilers climbed to eighth, while French bulldogs and several other breeds gained ground; the rankings cover newly registered dogs in the AKC’s recognized breeds, not mixed-breed dogs."}

{"summary":"Anthony surprised his sister Anelle at her graduation by showing up in a cap and gown, making her struggle to hold back laughter while she sat onstage. Because he had graduated the year before and was well-known, many guests recognized him; others assumed he was a graduate the administration had stopped from walking."}

{"summary":"A viral fan theory reimagines Friends as a fantasy created by Phoebe, who is depicted in an alternate ending alone at Central Perk, imagining herself among five real friends. The dark interpretation draws on her stories of homelessness and a troubled past, and suggests all 10 seasons were her fevered daydream about having friends."}

{"summary":"The article claims that bay leaves—especially dried, crushed leaves—can repel cockroaches because the insects dislike their smell. It recommends placing them around room corners, kitchens, and gardens, though it offers no evidence that this method can eliminate an infestation."}

{ "summary": "A man identified as Michel Bechard was taken into custody Friday after stripping naked near a White House security gate. The Secret Service said he assaulted an officer as officers tried to subdue him." }

{ "summary": "Texas State Board of Education candidate Mary Lou Bruner, known for promoting conspiracy theories and extreme views on social media, lost by a wide margin to chiropractor and school board president Kevin M. Ellis. The article celebrates the result as an encouraging sign for Texas public education." }

{ "summary": "The FBI arrested an unnamed man suspected of spraying a mixture of hand cleaner, water, and mouse poison on food and produce at supermarkets in Michigan, including Whole Foods and Meijer. Stores discarded and sanitized affected items, no illnesses have been reported, and the suspect’s motive is unknown." }

{ "summary": "Madden NFL 16’s annual simulation predicts the Carolina Panthers will beat the Denver Broncos 24–20 in Super Bowl 50, with Cam Newton named MVP. The game has correctly picked the winner in nine of its 12 predictions, though its forecast is no guarantee of the real outcome." }

{ "summary": "The full moon on Aug. 10, 2014, will be the year’s largest supermoon because it coincides closely with the moon’s nearest point to Earth, making it appear up to 14 percent closer and 30 percent brighter than ordinary full moons. It may coincide with the Perseid meteor shower, which peaks Aug. 10–13; another supermoon is expected Sept. 9." }

{"summary":"Adrienne Maloof and Paul Nassif announced that they have resolved all outstanding issues in their divorce and related litigation. The former couple said their priority is the well-being of their three children and that they will move forward as co-parents."}

{ "summary": "A collection of interviews shows Shailene Woodley repeatedly using “badass” to describe everything from Divergent stunts and co-star Theo James to author Veronica Roth and the film’s heroine, Tris. The article highlights how the word became a signature expression as Woodley discussed Tris’s growth from an ordinary person into a strong, capable character." }

{ "summary": "Shrinking Arctic sea ice is making it harder for polar bears to hunt seals, and researchers say this pressure is contributing to more frequent cannibalism. A National Geographic video captures a male polar bear chasing a female and her cub, then killing the cub." }

{ "summary": "The article spotlights ten overlooked pop releases from March, ranging from The Drums’ buoyant post-punk and Offaiah’s club-ready dance track to Nelly Furtado’s ethereal ballad and Amine’s hard-hitting rap. It praises each song’s distinctive appeal, including nostalgic ’80s and ’90s pop, quirky lyrics, inventive production, and irresistible hooks." }

{"summary":"Tesla’s “Part Deux” master plan calls for expanding its lineup with a compact SUV and pickup, developing electric semis and urban transport, and making vehicle production faster and more efficient. The company frames these ambitions as part of a broader push toward sustainability, while also seeking growth in popular vehicle markets."}

{ "summary": "A preliminary study of nearly 26,000 men found that Viagra use was associated with a higher risk of melanoma, though researchers say the results are not enough to change prescriptions and need further investigation. The finding conflicts with earlier mouse research suggesting Viagra might help fight melanoma." }

{"summary":"BuzzFeed rounds up 23 humorous products for people who dislike socializing, including conversation-deterring clothing, solitude-themed pillows and accessories, and gifts celebrating silence and alone time. Items range from scarves and mugs to a bed tent, with prices and retailer links provided."}

{ "summary": "The article argues that Apple’s rumored acquisition of Tesla is unrealistic because Tim Cook’s cautious, operational leadership would clash with Elon Musk’s independent, risk-taking style and broader ambitions. A takeover would likely force Musk out, undermining Tesla’s mission and making the deal a poor fit for both companies." }

{"summary":"Though “Breaking Bad” ended last year, AMC is campaigning for Emmy recognition with provocative billboards around Los Angeles. The show hopes the final eight episodes of Season 5 will win more awards after its Outstanding Drama Series victory last year; its upcoming spin-off, “Better Call Saul,” may carry on its legacy."}

{"summary":"The article ranks the three longest commercial flights then in operation: Air India’s roughly 9,400-mile route, an Emirates flight of about 8,820 miles, and Qantas’s 8,577-mile journey. Qantas planned a Perth–London nonstop for 2018, while Singapore Airlines’ proposed 10,252-mile Singapore–New York route could soon break the distance record."}

{"summary":"Netflix announced that Season 2 of “Orange Is the New Black” will premiere June 6, revealing the date during the credits of “House of Cards” Season 2. Plot details remain scarce, but Laura Prepon will return as Alex for at least four episodes, and Lori Petty is joining the cast."}

{"summary":"The article praises Defence Minister Manohar Parrikar for proposing women’s combat battalions across India’s Army, Navy and Air Force, along with women’s entry through the National Defence Academy and Sainik schools. It presents these proposals as a major step toward equality, while noting that women’s military roles and service terms remain limited and that change would be gradual."}

{"summary":"Pokémon CEO Tsunekazu Ishihara said the Nintendo NX aims to redefine the boundary between home and handheld consoles, lending support to rumors of a hybrid system. The article reviews speculation about touchscreens and detachable controllers, but notes that details remain unconfirmed and NX is only a codename."}

{"summary":"Prince George’s signature shorts reflect a centuries-old British aristocratic custom, etiquette expert William Hanson says. Historically, young boys wore gowns before being “breeched” into shorts, while trousers were associated with adult men; the tradition remains popular among the royal family and upper classes."}

{"summary":"Robert Schwentke will direct “Insurgent,” replacing Neil Burger, who is not returning because of the sequel’s tight schedule. The film, based on Veronica Roth’s “Divergent” series and starring Shailene Woodley, is scheduled for release March 20, 2015; Akiva Goldsman is writing the screenplay."}

{"summary":"Golden State remains No. 1 in the NBA Power Rankings for a fourth straight week after winning nine consecutive games, but Memphis is close behind with an NBA-best 15 wins, just two losses, and strong play on both ends. The 76ers remain a fixture at No. 30, while the article sets up a look at all 30 teams’ rankings."}

{"summary":"NPR’s Brian Boyer is developing Carebot, a tool funded by a $35,000 Knight Foundation grant, to help newsrooms measure stories’ impact beyond page views. Its proposed indicators include completion rates, reader responses, and social sharing, with the aim of rewarding journalism that engages audiences rather than clickbait."}

{ "summary": "The Sony World Photography Awards has revealed its shortlist, selected from more than 220,000 entries, with the winner due to be announced on 20 April. The featured photographs range from Mount Fuji and an Italian beach to scenes of religion, racism, economic change and personal hardship around the world." }

{"summary":"The article argues that a leather jacket is a versatile wardrobe staple for men, pairing well with casual and dressier outfits and carrying a long-standing association with cool style. It advises shoppers to choose a jacket style and budget that suit them, consider faux leather as a lower-cost trial, and avoid leather blazers."}

{"summary":"Niantic plans to introduce sponsored locations in Pokémon Go, where businesses pay to appear in the game and attract players to their stores. The article jokingly calls the model an unusually powerful form of advertising, imagining it could also draw crowds to concerts or protests."}

{"summary":"A partisan article claims a school sent home a form allowing parents to opt their children out of reciting the Pledge of Allegiance, and says a mother responded angrily. It frames the form as an attack on patriotism, uses inflammatory political rhetoric, and urges readers to support Donald Trump."}

{"summary":"Republican health policy expert Avik Roy argues that the GOP’s identification with opposition to civil rights, followed by intellectuals’ denial of its role in attracting white voters motivated by racial resentment, created conditions for Donald Trump’s rise. He predicts the party and conservative movement will fracture unless conservatives build a genuinely inclusive movement centered on individual liberty, though the article questions whether such a coalition can win politically."}

{ "summary": "Sacred Heart University student Nikki Yovino was charged with filing a false rape report after police said she recanted her accusation against two football players and admitted the sex was consensual. The players had lost their scholarships and been expelled; Yovino could face up to five years in prison if convicted." }

{"summary":"Airlines can deny passengers boarding because of overbooking, aircraft or weight limits, crew transportation needs, or violations of airline rules. When a flight is oversold, federal rules require carriers to seek volunteers first; involuntarily bumped passengers may qualify for extra compensation if their arrival is delayed by more than an hour."}

{"summary":"An internally flawless, emerald-cut 100-carat diamond sold for $22.1 million at Sotheby’s in New York, setting a record for the most expensive colorless diamond auctioned there. The anonymous bidder won by phone after just three minutes of bidding; the stone was one of only six perfect diamonds over 100 carats sold at auction in the previous 25 years."}

{"summary":"The article argues that traffic and social shares don’t prove people are reading content: heatmaps show readers often skim in an F-pattern, and many leave before reaching the end. To improve readership, marketers should account for mobile and other reading contexts, put key information first, keep sentences engaging, and use images, clear subheadings, short paragraphs, and scannable formatting."}

{ "summary": "A Loughborough University study suggests that an hour in a 40°C bath may burn about 126 calories—roughly as much as a 20–30-minute walk—and may help lower blood sugar by raising body temperature and releasing heat shock proteins. The article says baths could complement a healthy routine, not replace exercise or justify overeating." }

{"summary":"Former congressman Tom Perriello’s surprise bid for Virginia’s Democratic gubernatorial nomination challenges the party-backed Lt. Gov. Ralph Northam and echoes the establishment-versus-insurgent divisions exposed in the 2016 election. The contest, alongside a Republican primary featuring establishment favorite Ed Gillespie and Trump-aligned Corey Stewart, is expected to draw national attention as a test of both parties’ post-election identities."}

{ "summary": "Former Minneapolis Mayor R.T. Rybak suffered a massive heart attack while cross-country skiing and was hospitalized, but appeared upbeat, tweeting a poem about the scare and praising the ski trails. The incident came days after he completed 12 years as mayor; Betsy Hodges had taken over the office on Jan. 1." }

{"summary":"Rescued as a puppy from a roadside box, Snickle Fritz grew into a gentle giant who loves visiting his family’s next-door grandma. She gives him belly rubs and welcomes his kisses, making him overjoyed whenever they’re together."}

{ "summary": "An anonymous source told US Weekly that Rob Kardashian and Blac Chyna are expecting a girl and are excited about the news. Their baby is due in October, and the couple is reportedly preparing an extravagant nursery, though they have not publicly confirmed the gender." }

{ "summary": "The article questions claims that cow’s milk strengthens bones, arguing that pasteurization destroys beneficial bacteria, enzymes, and some nutrients, which it says may hinder calcium absorption. It also links high dairy consumption in the U.S. and European Union with high osteoporosis rates, but provides no study details to support the claims." }

{"summary":"The 2017 Oscars featured a historic best-picture mix-up, when “La La Land” was announced before the award was corrected to “Moonlight,” along with Viola Davis’s celebrated speech and Jimmy Kimmel’s political jokes and ongoing Matt Damon gag. Other highlights included wins by Mahershala Ali and “The Salesman,” director Asghar Farhadi’s protest of the U.S. travel ban, Kevin O’Connell’s first Oscar after 21 nominations, and audience members who became viral sensations."}

{"summary":"Artist Hanny Ahern created *When I Think About You I Text Myself*, a hotline that lets people send unsent messages to an anonymous number and receive them back months later, offering a safer outlet for impulsive feelings. The project aims to turn anxious texting into reflection and creative expression, while encouraging users to communicate authentically with real people."}

{"summary":"After overhearing two women make disparaging generalizations about Aboriginal people at a Perth cafe, Jarred Walls quietly sent them tea with a note identifying himself and his family as Aboriginal. He said he chose kindness over confrontation, hoping the gesture would make them think and help change attitudes."}

{"summary":"Salesforce recruiting chief Ana Recio, who oversees hiring more than 8,000 people annually, often opens interviews by asking candidates for their favorite “pump up” song and why. She says the icebreaker helps reveal personality and potential cultural fit; there’s no right answer, but how candidates respond can be informative."}

{"summary":"Sydney siblings Samuel and Bronte Leighton-Dore plan for Bronte to donate an egg, fertilised with Samuel’s partner Bradley’s sperm, with a surrogate carrying the child for the couple to raise. They say the arrangement will give both men a genetic link to their child, while highlighting legal complications for same-sex parents in Australia."}

{"summary":"Eurostat data show that almost 80% of European primary-school pupils learned a second language in 2014, while the UK introduced compulsory primary language education only recently, after most teaching had begun in secondary school. Although British schools’ language teaching expanded sharply from 2002 to 2010, the UK still ranks behind many European countries in pupils learning major languages."}

{ "summary": "Michigan mother Stacey Wehrman Feeley shared a photo of her three-year-old standing on a toilet, initially thinking it was funny, then learned her daughter was practising a preschool lockdown drill for a bathroom during a gun attack. In a Facebook post following the Orlando shooting, she urged politicians, innovators and the public to pursue practical gun-safety measures and mental-health support." }

{"summary":"A student’s report of possible gunshots prompted lockdowns at Valley Forge Military Academy and nearby Eastern and Cabrini universities in suburban Philadelphia. Police found no weapons or evidence of gunfire; the sound may have been bubble wrap popping, and normal activities resumed after about 90 minutes."}

{"summary":"A study of more than 63,000 adults found that exercising on just one or two days a week was linked to a lower risk of death than doing no exercise, even when participants fell short of activity guidelines. Researchers cautioned that the study relied on self-reported activity measured only once and did not assess injury risks."}

{ "summary": "Researchers tracking white-lipped peccaries in Brazil’s Cerrado discovered cave drawings of humans, geometric shapes, and animals—including armadillos, big cats, birds, and reptiles—thought to be 4,000 to 10,000 years old. The find highlights the region’s cultural and natural heritage, and conservationists hope to protect the cave sites and surrounding ecosystems." }

{"summary":"Danny Green says he doesn’t know whether Tim Duncan or Manu Ginobili will retire, as both Spurs veterans have yet to reveal their plans. With their production declining and David West reportedly opting out, San Antonio faces key roster decisions ahead of the June draft and July free agency."}

{ "summary": "Michael Easton began filming General Hospital on February 26, with his return set to air March 18. He’ll play a new character rather than the deceased Dr. Silas Clay; details remain undisclosed, despite rumors he may be a Cassadine." }

{"summary":"The article presents blue scenery as a simple way to ease stress, noting that the color can promote calm and relaxation and has been scientifically linked to reduced stress. It encourages readers to use soothing images and other personal “secret weapons” to restore balance."}

{ "summary": "The article ranks the 30 highest-paid golfers of all time by career tournament earnings, combining PGA Tour and European Tour winnings while avoiding double-counting majors and WGC events. Tiger Woods leads with $122.5 million, followed by Phil Mickelson at $94.6 million and Vijay Singh at $75.9 million." }

{"summary":"A wellness coach recommends making 2017 about appreciating your body rather than changing its appearance through dieting or weight-loss goals. Her suggestions include daily affirmations, focusing on how you feel, following more body-diverse and supportive social media accounts, enjoying movement, avoiding self-criticism, and spending less time on negative online influences."}

{"summary":"Inspired by her college professor’s openness about mental illness, Miles shared her own experience with depression and got an ambigram tattoo that reads “I’m fine” from one angle and “save me” from another. Her viral Facebook post helped her become an advocate, urging people to recognize that those around them may be struggling and that one person can make a difference."}

{ "summary": "Dermatologists say there is no need to shower daily: frequent hot showers can strip the skin’s natural oils, causing dryness, irritation, and worsening eczema. One expert says showering every other day is fine if you wash your hands and focus on odor-prone areas such as the armpits and groin." }

{ "summary": "Pornhub’s 2013 report found that U.S. visitors had the world’s longest average viewing sessions, at 10 minutes and 39 seconds, with Mississippi residents spending the longest per visit. The site recorded nearly 14.8 billion visits worldwide; January and Monday were the busiest viewing periods, while August and Sunday were the quietest." }

{ "summary": "A report commissioned by Southern California law firm Graham Donath ranks San Bernardino as California’s most dangerous city after weighing crime alongside poverty, unemployment, police staffing and other community factors. Though Oakland and Stockton have higher rates of violent crime, San Bernardino’s poverty rate is 30.6%; Los Angeles ranks 19th." }

{ "summary": "A Brexit vote would trigger negotiations over the U.K.’s departure, likely intensify political divisions and raise major uncertainties about trade, investment, jobs and the rights of millions of Britons and EU migrants. It could also encourage other countries to leave the EU and prompt Scotland to seek another independence referendum." }

{"summary":"In an interview with American Way, Demi Lovato said she developed bulimia as a child and later struggled with self-harm and addiction, once believing she wouldn’t live to 21. She credited rehab and therapy with helping her recovery and managing bipolar disorder, and said former boyfriend Wilmer Valderrama helped save her life."}

{"summary":"Nine-year-old Molly Sings moved the judges on The Voice Kids Australia with an emotional performance of Kasey Chambers’ song “Am I Not Pretty Enough?” Her family watched proudly as the judges turned around, and Mel B urged Molly to join her team, praising her confidence and making a girl-to-girl appeal."}

{"summary":"Blogger Stuart Edge visited a Utah animal shelter to volunteer, then learned its dogs had no beds and slept on hard concrete. He and friends bought a carload of fluffy cushions, giving the dogs a chance to enjoy some outdoor play and then settle into their new, more comfortable beds."}

{"summary":"The article describes an unverified Pokémon Go theory that using Incense in an area with no nearby streets, gyms, PokéStops, or wild Pokémon spawns may attract more rare Pokémon. It says video evidence appears convincing but notes the trick has not been confirmed."}

{ "summary": "Candice Swanepoel will wear Victoria’s Secret’s 2013 $10 million Royal Fantasy Bra, her first time modeling the show’s signature final look. Designed by Mouawad, the red-and-blue set features more than 4,200 gems, including a 52-carat ruby, set in 18-karat gold." }

{"summary":"J.K. Rowling said Hagrid could not produce a Patronus, a difficult spell. Fans reacted with sadness, and the article speculates that his painful past may have left him without enough happy memories to conjure one."}

{ "summary": "Domo’s annual “Data Never Sleeps” report says 3.6 billion people are now online, and the world uses more than 18 million megabytes of wireless data each minute. Online activity has also surged, with Tinder recording nearly a million swipes per minute and Giphy serving about 598,000 GIFs." }

{"summary":"Katy Perry announced that the music video for “Roar” would debut on September 5, describing it as a “motion theory adventure” filmed in “Junglescope.” Her album *Prism* was scheduled for release on October 22."}

{"summary":"The article celebrates *iCarly* star Jennette McCurdy as a witty, outspoken Twitter favorite, highlighting her sarcastic bio and humorous posts about beauty, food, clothes, and everyday life. It also points readers to other funny celebrity Twitter accounts, including Anna Kendrick, Lena Dunham, and Sarah Silverman."}

{ "summary": "A report from analyst Kevin Wang suggests the iPhone 7’s base storage may rise from 16GB to 32GB, addressing complaints that 16GB fills quickly with photos, apps, and cached data. The article also notes rumors of subtler antenna lines and improved cameras, but emphasizes that Apple has not confirmed any details." }

{ "summary": "The article argues that frequent added-sugar consumption can reinforce cravings through the brain’s reward system and advises readers to cut back by spotting sugar’s many names, avoiding sweetened drinks, and making sweet foods and beverages at home. It emphasizes that occasional treats and whole fruit are compatible with reducing added sugar." }

{"summary":"DC Films co-head Geoff Johns confirmed that the 2017 superhero team-up will be titled simply *Justice League*, without an added subtitle. The article frames the straightforward name as a response to criticism of *Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice*’s convoluted title; Zack Snyder will direct from a screenplay by Chris Terrio."}

{"summary":"The article profiles computer science student Jia Li, whose waist-length hair has a subtle wave from a perm at the ends and is maintained with Lush shampoo. For healthy skin, she says she eats fruit each morning and drinks water mixed with honey and lemon."}

{"summary":"Michigan mother Stacey Wehrman Feeley said she broke down after learning her three-year-old daughter was standing on a toilet to practise hiding during a preschool lockdown drill. Sharing the photo, Feeley urged US politicians to address gun violence, arguing that even measures that reduce shootings without eliminating them are worthwhile."}

{ "summary": "The article argues that urinating in the shower can save water by avoiding a toilet flush, estimating a person could conserve about 2,555 litres annually. It adds that urine is not toxic to skin when washed away, though the water savings depend on keeping showers brief." }

{ "summary": "Trey Harris says United stopped him from bringing his medically necessary Segway miniPro on a honeymoon flight, despite prior approval and confirmation from TSA and a United representative. He and his husband left it at the gate, faced added costs and distress after being told it was hazardous material, and Harris is seeking an apology and assurance he can travel with it in the future." }

{ "summary": "The IRS spent $10,000 producing a four-minute 2011 parody of “The Apprentice” for a conference, in which employees pitch ways to cut travel costs before being fired by a fake Donald Trump. The agency said such videos would not be made under its current cost and content policies, while Rep. Charles Boustany criticized the spending as frivolous." }

{"summary":"Netflix will become the exclusive streaming distributor of the acclaimed Egyptian documentary “The Square” early next year, giving it an early, Oscar-season release window after a limited theatrical run. The acquisition advances Netflix’s push into original film programming and signals interest in shortening traditional distribution windows, though the film faces stiff competition for an Oscar nomination."}

{ "summary": "The article recommends investing in quality window coverings, linens and towels, upholstered furniture, rugs, mattresses, original artwork, and countertops for comfort, durability, and lasting value. It also offers ways to save, such as altering ready-made curtains, buying secondhand furniture, using a mattress topper, supporting emerging artists, or choosing affordable countertop materials." }

{"summary":"Elite Dangerous: Horizons launches on Xbox One June 3 for $30, including the base game and the Planetary Landings and The Engineers expansions. The Engineers arrives on PC May 26 alongside a major free update, and Frontier outlined future features such as multicrew and ship-launched fighters; a PlayStation 4 release is planned but undated."}

{"summary":"The article argues that saying “busy” has become a hollow status symbol that can undermine authentic conversation and connection. Constant busyness may also reduce productivity, mask work on low-priority tasks, and reflect poor energy management; focused work, rest, scheduled downtime, and helping others can make people more effective and less pressed for time."}

{"summary":"A teaser for Jonathan Glazer’s *Under the Skin* shows Scarlett Johansson as an alien traveling through Scotland amid surreal, unsettling imagery. The film premiered at Telluride to strong reviews, with critics praising its haunting visuals and Johansson’s performance, but it had no U.S. distributor at the time."}

{"summary":"The article argues that Jon Heder’s career cooled after *Napoleon Dynamite* because audiences typecast him, many later films flopped, and he lacked the celebrity controversy studios often exploit. It also notes he has stayed busy with voice acting and web projects, suggesting he may prefer the creative freedom of work outside Hollywood."}

{ "summary": "California passed SB 32 and AB 197, codifying a target to cut greenhouse-gas emissions 40% below 1990 levels by 2030 while increasing legislative oversight and attention to communities most affected by pollution. The author credits a broad coalition, public support, constituent outreach, newspaper editorials, and key lawmakers for turning around a vote that had seemed unlikely." }

{"summary":"Cats knock objects over mainly to get their owners’ attention—often because they want food—and to practice instinctive paw-swiping behaviors linked to their predatory nature. The article says deaf cats may do it even more because they aren’t startled by the noise."}

{ "summary": "A ranking dated May 22, 2020, lists the world’s 10 most valuable brands, led by Apple at $205.5 billion, Google at $167.7 billion, and Microsoft; Amazon and Facebook round out the top five. The list also includes Coca-Cola, Samsung, Disney, Toyota, and McDonald’s, spanning technology, retail, food, entertainment, and automotive industries." }

{ "summary": "When a scammer posing as an IRS agent demanded payment, Charlie recognized the fraud and turned the call into a conversation about his Christian faith, saying his debts had already been paid by God. The article says he exposed the scammer, urged him to change his ways, and led him in the “Sinner’s Prayer.”" }

{ "summary": "A Savills comparison of business setup costs relative to GDP ranked Singapore the best-value city for foreign business among 10 global hubs, with a score of 16.1; Mumbai ranked lowest at 74.7. The report’s authors said Singapore’s high revenue potential helps justify its real-estate costs, adding to its long-standing reputation as a leading place to invest and do business." }

{"summary":"A satirical article questions a report that Hillary Clinton avoids drinking water, contrasting it with her 2008 claim that she drank “tons” and citing videos of her drinking water in later years. It jokingly suggests her staff may be misleading the press and dubs the supposed controversy “Waterghazi.”"}

{"summary":"Oxfam’s food index ranked the Netherlands first among 125 countries for food availability, affordability, quality and health, while Chad placed last; the United States and Japan tied at 21st, held back by health and affordability measures. Oxfam said 840 million people go hungry despite sufficient global food supplies, citing unequal distribution and barriers including underinvestment, trade policies and climate change."}

{ "summary": "Northwestern’s Medill School plans to shut down its popular alumni email list on May 30 and move communications to its new OurNorthwestern social network, prompting widespread objections from graduates who rely on email for jobs, advice and staying in touch. The university says the new site offers additional services and isn’t being adopted for cost reasons, while alumni have begun setting up a Google Group as an alternative." }

{ "summary": "Google’s preliminary Black Friday 2013 shopping data ranked Ugg boots fourth among trending gifts, making them the top fashion item; video game consoles, tablets, and Minecraft Legos ranked higher. Their popularity persisted despite fading trend status, with a spring survey finding that more than a quarter of American women owned a pair." }

{ "summary": "After a stranger sent Samantha Mawdsley an unsolicited penis photo following her restaurant review, she replied with similar images and shared the exchange online, using mocking stickers to expose his behavior. Her post spread widely, and she hopes it will deter sexual harassment and make men think twice before sending such images." }

{"summary":"Emily Blunt said Julie Andrews approved of her playing Mary Poppins in the upcoming Mary Poppins Returns, easing Blunt’s nerves about taking on the iconic role. The sequel will draw more from the original books than the 1964 film, giving Blunt room to interpret a somewhat different version of the character."}

{"summary":"Two unidentified Western tourists accused of stealing a bicycle were paraded around Gili Trawangan wearing signs confessing to theft, reviving questions about the islands’ informal “walk of shame” punishment. Locals and tourism officials say the practice deters crime, but its legal basis and fairness are unclear, and the pair’s identities and opportunity to defend themselves have not been confirmed."}

{"summary":"Mary Shelley, daughter of feminist writer Mary Wollstonecraft and philosopher William Godwin, eloped with poet Percy Bysshe Shelley as a teenager and began writing Frankenstein at 19 during a stay in Geneva. The article recounts debated influences on the novel, its anonymous publication and later revisions, and the personal tragedies that shaped Shelley’s life and work, including the loss of two children and Percy."}

{ "summary": "In a “Super Soul Sunday” conversation, Maya Angelou tells Oprah that prayer brings something wonderful to both those prayed for and the person praying. She says inner centeredness helps her feel at peace, and what she knows for sure is that love saves her and can save everyone." }

{ "summary": "Cornell University named Elizabeth Garrett, currently provost at the University of Southern California, as its first female president. She will succeed David Skorton on July 1, 2015, as Cornell marks its 150th anniversary and develops a technology campus in New York City." }

{"summary":"Director David Lowery says Disney contracts prohibit films from depicting beheadings, impalement, or smoking, though the article notes Disney movies have included examples of all three. The rules may have changed over time and could depend on a film’s rating or studio; a 2015 report said smoking was barred in G, PG, and PG-13 films except when historically relevant."}
